title: EU and UK Connect Digital Plans with Closer Economic Cooperation

sources.name: European Commission
sources.title: Questions and answers on the outcomes of the 2026 EU-UK Summit

paragraphs.en: European Union and United Kingdom leaders
paragraphs.zh: 歐盟與英國領導人

paragraphs.en: met in Brussels on November 20, 2026,
paragraphs.zh: 於2026年11月20日在布魯塞爾會面，

paragraphs.en: for their second summit.
paragraphs.zh: 舉行雙方第二次高峰會。

paragraphs.en: Among the plans they announced
paragraphs.zh: 他們宣布的計畫中，

paragraphs.en: was a digital partnership intended for early 2027.
paragraphs.zh: 包括預計於2027年初啟動的數位夥伴關係。

paragraphs.en: The meeting linked technology cooperation
paragraphs.zh: 這場會議將科技合作

paragraphs.en: with wider efforts on trade and economic security.
paragraphs.zh: 與貿易及經濟安全方面更廣泛的努力連結起來。

paragraphs.en: It followed the first summit in London in May 2025.
paragraphs.zh: 這是繼2025年5月倫敦首次峰會之後的會議。

paragraphs.en: The possible digital agenda includes
paragraphs.zh: 可能的數位議程包括

paragraphs.en: reliable connections, artificial intelligence, and critical technologies.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠的連線、人工智慧與關鍵技術。

paragraphs.en: The European Commission's explanation also mentions
paragraphs.zh: 歐盟執委會的說明也提到

paragraphs.en: quantum technology, digital wallets, and online safety.
paragraphs.zh: 量子技術、數位錢包與網路使用安全。

paragraphs.en: The intention is to organize practical cooperation
paragraphs.zh: 其用意是把實務合作

paragraphs.en: under a common structure.
paragraphs.zh: 納入共同架構。

paragraphs.en: These subjects touch both the infrastructure people use
paragraphs.zh: 這些主題既涉及人們使用的基礎設施，

paragraphs.en: and the ways they interact with digital services.
paragraphs.zh: 也涉及人們與數位服務互動的方式。

paragraphs.en: The joint statement connects this work
paragraphs.zh: 聯合聲明將這項工作

paragraphs.en: with innovation and opportunities for businesses and consumers.
paragraphs.zh: 與創新，以及企業和消費者的機會連結起來。

paragraphs.en: It also says the partners will preserve
paragraphs.zh: 聲明也表示，雙方將保有

paragraphs.en: their ability to set their own rules.
paragraphs.zh: 各自制定規則的能力。

paragraphs.en: That combination is important:
paragraphs.zh: 這樣的結合很重要：

paragraphs.en: cooperation can deepen while each side
paragraphs.zh: 合作可以持續深化，而每一方

paragraphs.en: retains responsibility for its regulatory choices.
paragraphs.zh: 仍對自身的監管選擇負責。

paragraphs.en: The partners announced an intention to launch this partnership,
paragraphs.zh: 雙方宣布有意啟動這項夥伴關係，

paragraphs.en: with further work still ahead.
paragraphs.zh: 後續仍有工作要完成。

paragraphs.en: Economic security is another shared priority.
paragraphs.zh: 經濟安全是另一項共同優先事項。

paragraphs.en: The leaders agreed to establish a dialogue
paragraphs.zh: 領導人同意建立對話機制，

paragraphs.en: for coordinating their policies.
paragraphs.zh: 用來協調雙方政策。

paragraphs.en: The statement identifies cooperation on export controls,
paragraphs.zh: 聲明列出的合作領域包括出口管制、

paragraphs.en: risks to important infrastructure, and dependable supply chains.
paragraphs.zh: 重要基礎設施的風險，以及可靠的供應鏈。

paragraphs.en: Early warnings about supply disruptions are also included.
paragraphs.zh: 其中也包括對供應中斷的預警。

paragraphs.en: This gives the partnership a practical focus
paragraphs.zh: 這讓夥伴關係有了實際焦點，

paragraphs.en: beyond general expressions of friendship.
paragraphs.zh: 超越一般性的友好表態。

paragraphs.en: Energy cooperation already has an established framework
paragraphs.zh: 能源合作已有既定架構，

paragraphs.en: within the Trade and Cooperation Agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 位於《貿易與合作協定》之中。

paragraphs.en: The summit welcomed a decision
paragraphs.zh: 這次峰會歡迎一項決定，

paragraphs.en: to extend its energy provisions until March 31, 2028.
paragraphs.zh: 把能源相關條款的適用延長至2028年3月31日。

paragraphs.en: Those provisions cover issues such as energy trade
paragraphs.zh: 這些條款涵蓋能源貿易等事項，

paragraphs.en: and cooperation between operators and regulators.
paragraphs.zh: 以及營運單位與監管機關之間的合作。

paragraphs.en: Continuing an existing arrangement is one part
paragraphs.zh: 延續既有安排，是其中一項工作，

paragraphs.en: of a relationship developing along several tracks.
paragraphs.zh: 整體關係則同時沿著多條路徑發展。

paragraphs.en: A separate negotiation concerns possible British participation
paragraphs.zh: 另一項談判涉及英國可能參與

paragraphs.en: in the EU's internal electricity market.
paragraphs.zh: 歐盟內部電力市場。

paragraphs.en: The partners aim to finish those talks in 2027,
paragraphs.zh: 雙方目標是在2027年完成談判，

paragraphs.en: subject to agreement on the final terms.
paragraphs.zh: 但仍須就最終條件達成協議。

paragraphs.en: This would be linked to a British financial contribution
paragraphs.zh: 這也將與英國提供的一筆財務分攤款連結，

paragraphs.en: for reducing differences between EU regions.
paragraphs.zh: 用於縮小歐盟各地區之間的差距。

paragraphs.en: The proposed market arrangement and the extension
paragraphs.zh: 這項提議中的市場安排，與延長

paragraphs.en: of existing energy cooperation are different steps.
paragraphs.zh: 既有能源合作，是不同的步驟。

paragraphs.en: Leaders also welcomed completed negotiations
paragraphs.zh: 領導人也歡迎談判完成，

paragraphs.en: on plant and animal health arrangements
paragraphs.zh: 內容涉及植物與動物衛生安排，

paragraphs.en: and linking their emissions trading systems.
paragraphs.zh: 以及連結雙方的排放交易制度。

paragraphs.en: The joint statement sets 2028 as the intended year
paragraphs.zh: 聯合聲明把2028年列為預計年份，

paragraphs.en: for applying those agreements.
paragraphs.zh: 準備在該年開始適用這些協議。

paragraphs.en: Further procedures remain necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 後續程序仍然必要。

paragraphs.en: For companies, the distinction between finishing talks
paragraphs.zh: 對企業而言，完成談判

paragraphs.en: and having new arrangements in operation matters
paragraphs.zh: 與新安排實際運作之間的差別很重要，

paragraphs.en: when planning future activity.
paragraphs.zh: 尤其是在規劃未來活動時。

paragraphs.en: The United Kingdom left the EU in January 2020.
paragraphs.zh: 英國於2020年1月離開歐盟。

paragraphs.en: The Commission says existing agreements remain
paragraphs.zh: 執委會表示，既有協定仍然是

paragraphs.en: the foundation of the relationship.
paragraphs.zh: 雙方關係的基礎。

paragraphs.en: The new plans build on that foundation
paragraphs.zh: 新計畫建立在這個基礎之上，

paragraphs.en: across several policy areas.
paragraphs.zh: 涵蓋數個政策領域。

paragraphs.en: Together, the announcements show how digital development,
paragraphs.zh: 整體而言，這些公告顯示，數位發展、

paragraphs.en: energy cooperation, and economic security
paragraphs.zh: 能源合作與經濟安全，

paragraphs.en: are becoming connected parts of the partnership.
paragraphs.zh: 正成為這項夥伴關係中相互關聯的部分。

agreed.meaning: 同意、商定；文中亦指已同意承擔的

ahead.meaning: 在前方、尚待完成；still ahead指仍待完成

along.meaning: 沿著；along several tracks指沿多條路徑發展

an.meaning: 一個、一種；母音發音前的不定冠詞

applying.meaning: 適用、開始實施；文中指開始適用協議

are.meaning: 是；也可作被動語態的助動詞

artificial.meaning: 人工的；artificial intelligence指人工智慧

as.meaning: 作為；presented as指以某種形式呈現

be.meaning: 是；與過去分詞連用可構成被動語態

both.meaning: 兩者都；both A and B指A與B兩者

build.meaning: 建立；build on指建立在既有基礎之上

chains.meaning: 鏈、鏈條（複數）；supply chains指供應鏈

commission.meaning: 執委會；文中指歐盟執委會

commission's.meaning: 執委會的；文中指歐盟執委會的

concerns.meaning: 關注、涉及（動詞）；也作名詞複數指考量或關切事項

connections.meaning: 連線（複數）；文中指通訊連線

disruptions.meaning: 中斷（複數）；supply disruptions指供應中斷

for.meaning: 為了、對於；也表示某時段的

future.meaning: 未來；也可作形容詞表示未來的

has.meaning: 有；也可作現在完成式助動詞

in.meaning: 在某時間、領域或範圍中

intended.meaning: 預定的；intended for early 2027指預計於2027年初啟動

interact.meaning: 互動；interact with digital services指與數位服務互動

is.meaning: 是；也可作被動或進行式的助動詞

it.meaning: 它；依上下文指峰會或聯合聲明

its.meaning: 它的；依上下文指各方或既有協定的

of.meaning: …的；表示所屬、性質、內容等關係

on.meaning: 關於、就某事；也表示日期

quantum.meaning: 量子的；quantum technology指量子技術

remain.meaning: 仍然保持、留在某種狀態

subject.meaning: 取決於、須符合；subject to agreement指以達成協議為條件

that.meaning: 那個；也可引導內容子句或關係子句

the.meaning: 定冠詞，指特定或前文提過的事物

their.meaning: 他們的、雙方的；文中指歐盟與英國及其領導人的

they.meaning: 他們；文中指歐盟與英國領導人

to.meaning: 到、向；也用於不定詞，接動詞原形

wallets.meaning: 錢包（複數）；digital wallets指數位錢包

was.meaning: be動詞的過去式；也與現在分詞構成過去進行式

while.meaning: 當…時；也表示同時進行某事

will.meaning: 將會；表示預期未來情形

with.meaning: 與、透過；也表示具備某項條件

work.meaning: 工作；文中指合作或後續政策工作

would.meaning: 將會、會；用於尚未實現的設想或條件

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the summit developments discussed in the article?

choices.text: The EU and UK announced plans linking digital cooperation with wider economic and energy work.
choices.explanation: 正確。第一段提出數位計畫與經濟安全，第五至第七段補充能源及其他經貿安排。

choices.text: The summit ended all cooperation between the EU and the UK.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。全文描述深化合作及延續既有安排，並非終止合作。

choices.text: Every planned agreement became operational on November 20, 2026.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。數位夥伴關係預計2027年初啟動，部分談判及適用程序也仍待完成。

choices.text: The article focuses only on a new online shopping application.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章談的是跨政府的科技與經濟合作，不是單一購物應用程式。

quiz.explanation: 主旨是多軌合作同時推進：數位夥伴關係、經濟安全、既有能源條款及新的市場談判。不同工作有不同階段，不能都視為立即完成。

evidence.quote: The meeting linked technology cooperation with wider efforts on trade and economic security.
Together, the announcements show how digital development, energy cooperation, and economic security are becoming connected parts of the partnership.

quiz.question: What is the most reasonable interpretation of the two energy developments?

choices.text: Extending existing energy provisions automatically completes electricity market negotiations.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第六段明確區分既有能源合作延長與新的電力市場安排。

choices.text: Both developments require the UK to stop all energy trade immediately.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章描述延續合作及探索參與市場，沒有要求停止交易。

choices.text: One continues an established framework, while the other still requires agreement on a new market arrangement.
choices.explanation: 正確。第五段是既有能源條款延長，第六段是英國參與內部電力市場的另一項談判。

choices.text: The UK was confirmed as participating in the internal electricity market at the summit.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第六段使用possible及subject to agreement，並指出目標是在2027年完成談判。

quiz.explanation: 兩項措施的狀態不同：延長既有能源條款已有決定；新的市場參與安排則仍有最終條件與財務分攤等談判內容。兩者不能混為一談。

evidence.quote: The summit welcomed a decision to extend its energy provisions until March 31, 2028.
The partners aim to finish those talks in 2027, subject to agreement on the final terms.

quiz.question: What does the article suggest about how businesses should interpret the announcements?

choices.text: They can assume all future benefits have already been delivered.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三與第七段都指出仍有後續工作及程序。

choices.text: They can treat the digital partnership as proof that both sides have identical rules.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第三段說雙方仍保有各自制定規則的能力。

choices.text: They can ignore whether agreements are actually in operation.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第七段明確指出，談判完成與實際運作的差別會影響規劃。

choices.text: They need to distinguish intentions, completed negotiations, and arrangements that are actually operating.
choices.explanation: 正確。第三段是預計啟動的數位合作，第六段仍在談判，第七段則區分談判與實際適用。

quiz.explanation: 文章以不同時間與程序說明公告的實際意義。企業理解這些消息時，需要分辨政策意向、談判進度與生效運作狀態，不能把它們視為同一件事。

evidence.quote: The partners announced an intention to launch this partnership, with further work still ahead.
For companies, the distinction between finishing talks and having new arrangements in operation matters when planning future activity.
